About and privacy
About Sheket

Sheket blocks election spam calls before they ring. It checks each incoming call against a list of numbers kept on your phone, so no network is used during a call. The list is built from user reports: a number is added only after at least 3 different installs on at least 2 different networks report it. The app downloads the latest list from the internet.
Calls from your contacts are never screened. Sheket does not ask for access to your contacts, so Android only asks it about callers who are not in them.

When you report a call, Sheket sends only: a random install ID created when the app was first opened (not linked to you, your phone number or your advertising ID), the platform (Android), the report type (call), the reported number, and the app version.
A report never includes your contacts, call audio, message text or your location.
Reports are deleted after 30 days. Your IP address is not stored; only a salted hash of its network block is kept, and it is also deleted after 30 days.
